project.purpose: Source-bound identification of two distinct Next responsibilities actually consumed by native authority/catalog and cross-domain Gate callers. Do not confuse file/source graph membership with runtime verifier or domain acceptance.

nodes.label: ExternalAuthorityRecordAndObservationCatalog
nodes.responsibility: Validate version-scoped external authority records and independently observed currentness, then derive a disposable discoverability index.
inputs: registered authority records and currentness observation JSON
outputs: validated authority identity/relation map and rebuildable index or explicit invalid-record error
nodes.behavioralContract: Source/version/observation relations are checked, but authority discovery does not decide task applicability, issue external provider permissions, or establish current normative compliance.
acceptance: check_authority_catalog_r1.py imports authority_catalog and invokes existing catalog validation; test_authority_catalog.py exercises the public behavior.
Currentness is reported only at the represented source/observation scope, not as deployed/provider runtime proof.

nodes.label: TaskLocalCrossDomainBindingQualification
nodes.responsibility: Validate cross-domain verifier/task binding JSON and resolve bounded repository-file references for task-local Gate consumers without becoming a Composition engine.
inputs: cross-domain binding JSON and repository-root-relative evidence reference
outputs: validated binding or canonical contained source-file path; invalid schema or path fails closed
nodes.behavioralContract: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 and canonical repo containment guard admission; a valid binding cannot make a verifier PASS, prove consumer behavior, or authorize effects.
acceptance: Research Artifact and Web Security Gate sources both import validate_binding and resolve_repo_file, so this responsibility has multiple distinct static consumers.
Path qualification checks namespace containment and file presence; content provenance and dynamic execution need independent evidence.

gaps: Next's broader task-local method selection and numerous experimental domain producers were not promoted to independent LEGO without bounded consumer/replaceability evidence.
No declared edge connects NX01 and NX02: their source-level callers are distinct, so inventing a dependency would misrepresent the architecture.
All cross-Owner implementation, dynamic consumer, deployed currentness and formal-model refinement relations remain scoped UNKNOWN.
